description: Overflow (L5, L6). A budget smaller than the required content never removes it: the agent block, the document-scoped constraint, the danger and the selected section still appear, budget.fits is false, and content that is not required is replaced by pointers recorded as budget omissions. Completeness parts: budget fails, coverage and resolution hold; complete is the conjunction of the parts.

requests.name: a full view over budget keeps the required content and omits the filler

complete.note: complete ignores the budget today; t-63 makes it the conjunction of coverage, resolution and budget

requests.name: a section read over budget keeps the section and the rules
a brief view over budget keeps the required content
a budget that fits omits nothing and is complete
